evidence.observation: Growth pressure was 2.983 Torr, consistent with the preceding approximately 2.98 Torr baseline.

Pressure reached 3.131 Torr despite stable argon flow (100.6 sccm), temperature (750.4 C), and low exhaust oxygen (2.4 ppm); this suggests emerging pressure-control or exhaust-path deviation, not an identified fault.

args.missing_evidence: Pressure acceptance limits and an independent pressure/exhaust-conductance check are needed to confirm the deviation and distinguish exhaust restriction from gauge or pressure-control error; sample characterization is not yet available.
